observations.why: The declarative rule imposes a prerequisite on deployment, enacting permission and control rather than reciprocity or pooling.

evidence.quote: the whole reason for the gate

observations.why: The explanation frames the gate as a consequence justified by prior failures, linking choice to organizational cost and control.
The labeled gate states a mandatory condition, performing an authority-based constraint on deploys.
The scope statement extends the same rule across deployment environments, reinforcing centralized rule application.
Naming an owner assigns governance responsibility through role and rank; the session presents this assignment rather than Quinton performing it directly.
